title: Shattered Mosaic
description: A surreal collage-style painting depicting a cracked and fragmented surface composed of irregular shards. Visible elements include a grey alien with a pink collar in a yellow frame, a white fox-like creature on black, a red teacup with Korean text, multiple stylized cat drawings, blue eyes, and a glowing futuristic hexagonal device at the bottom.
